Mixed uses and shared escape routes
Record each use and shared route. Confirm which occupancy provisions govern the arrangement.
Record materials and activities affecting escape. Confirm the applicable hazard classification before choosing egress criteria.
Walking surfaces and changes in level
Document damaged surfaces, slopes and unexpected changes in level along the route.
Record the clear opening and measurement location. Check applicable capacity criteria and exceptions.
Observe opening direction, interference and operating effort. Record the door location and applicable occupancy conditions.
Document how occupants release each door, including keys, tools, alarms or special operations. Verify permitted arrangements and exceptions.
Record where occupants can leave the stair, door identification and unlocking arrangements. Verify the applicable reentry provisions.
Record occupant-load basis, route dimensions and constrictions. Attach the capacity review used for the property.
Record exits serving each area and which are usable. Verify the required count for that use and load.
Sketch the available routes and their relationship. Check the arrangement against the applicable criteria.
Record the starting point, route and measured distance. Identify the criteria used to evaluate it.
Follow the discharge route and document restrictions or interruptions. Verify the required destination and arrangement.
Record dark areas and lighting conditions along the route. Attach measurements when needed for the applicable criteria.
Record equipment locations, test evidence and observed failures. Verify applicable test and performance criteria.
Document missing, hidden, damaged or confusing signs and the approach direction from which they were observed.
Identify the area and contents. Verify the additional egress provisions applicable to that hazard.
Mechanical, boiler and furnace room access
Record the room use, equipment and available escape route. Verify room-specific provisions before making a finding.
Identify smoke partitions from approved information. Record openings, damage and changes that need review.
Identify smoke barriers and their boundaries. Document penetrations, openings and alterations for review.
Record seating layout, aisles and temporary changes. Verify the arrangement against the applicable assembly provisions.
Existing building alterations or change of use
Record what changed, the prior use and approval history. Review Chapter 7 application and exceptions before selecting requirements.
